scope: clean-room TEOB (2,2) ringdown and sampling assembly

provenance.source_scope: Appendix F.1 postmerger ansatz, with the contract's independently specified sampling/index rules
provenance.method: Torch FP64 synthetic checks and an independently derived natural-cubic tridiagonal solve; no external waveform implementation, oracle fit, or residual-selected parameter was used

conventions.join: full_time < auxiliary_time[0], followed by auxiliary samples from index 1
conventions.peak: degree-six polynomial through seven knots and one Newton step; three left neighbors required; last-two-knot linear continuation supplies missing right neighbors
conventions.merger_and_match: t_merger=t_peak-3 and t_match=t_merger+2 in initial-total-mass units
conventions.attachment_index: last strictly earlier joined knot, then one preceding knot
conventions.interpolation: natural cubic amplitude and phase separately, with exact natural endpoint second derivatives
conventions.epoch: coordinate start of returned support; no observer or peak-time shift

checks: independent seven-knot peak polynomial and right-support continuation
exact/off-knot and floating-point boundary attachment arithmetic
join support, fixed extension, signed amplitude preservation, and no amplitude renormalization
time translation, optional output grid, asymptotic QNM frequency, batches, finite gradients, and domain errors
natural cubic comparison with scipy.interpolate.CubicSpline(..., bc_type='natural') on a nonuniform knot grid

support_counts_from_public_fixture_state.benchmark_method: One warmed CPU FP64 natural_cubic_interpolate call on fixture time arrays reconstructed from state[0], with y=sin(0.01*t); output query uses the auxiliary spacing. Timings are indicative single-process measurements, not a parity claim.
support_counts_from_public_fixture_state.solver_storage: O(joined_samples) tridiagonal workspace; no dense joined-by-joined matrix

scope_limits: No physical corrected-NQC array assembly was run; the two public fixtures were inspected read-only for support counts and timing only while awaiting the NQC worker cache.
No full inspiral or postmerger trajectory validation was performed.
No production driver, default, fit, NQC target, or dispatch path was changed.
No amplitude rescaling, time optimization, phase optimization, or binary residual ranking is part of this component.
